text: Masters, treat your slaves justly and fairly, realizing that you too have a Master in heaven.
Persevere in prayer, being watchful in it with thanksgiving; [AA]
at the same time, pray for us, too, that God may open a door to us for the word, to speak of the mystery of Christ, for which I am in prison, [AB]
that I may make it clear, as I must speak.
Conduct yourselves wisely toward outsiders, making the most of the opportunity. [AC]
Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you know how you should respond to each one.
Tychicus, [2] my beloved brother, trustworthy minister, and fellow slave in the Lord, will tell you all the news of me. [AD]
I am sending him to you for this very purpose, so that you may know about us and that he may encourage your hearts,
together with Onesimus, a trustworthy and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here. [AE]
Aristarchus, [3] my fellow prisoner, sends you greetings, as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you have received instructions; if he comes to you, receive him), [AF]
and Jesus, [4] who is called Justus, who are of the circumcision; these alone are my co-workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.
Epaphras [5] sends you greetings; he is one of you, a slave of Christ [Jesus], always striving for you in his prayers so that you may be perfect and fully assured in all the will of God. [AG]
For I can testify that he works very hard for you and for those in Laodicea [6] and those in Hierapolis.
Luke [7] the beloved physician sends greetings, as does Demas. [AH]
Give greetings to the brothers in Laodicea and to Nympha and to the church in her house. [8]
And when this letter is read before you, have it read also in the church of the Laodiceans, and you yourselves read the one from Laodicea. [9]
And tell Archippus, "See that you fulfill the ministry [10] that you received in the Lord." [AI]
The greeting is in my own hand, [11] Paul's. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. [AJ]
